notes.title: V1.4 - EVENT SYSTEM - NEW RESEARCHES - FIXES - CHANGES
notes.content:
[b]EVENTS[/b]

[i]Events pop up when the right conditions are met, player is given 3 choices with different benefits and harms as their outcomes. There are 6 different initial events with more to come in the future![/i]
[list]
[*]Intro Event

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403207/2c8de2b772f6a16412fca2f8245621dcc2d973d1.png[/img]
[*]Solar Flares

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403207/0cbb3846a2b66eeb91bc7792918c76e0abf8b161.png[/img]
[*]Worker Strike

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403207/a3ae904de26b0f87da04d5a1bd546d0d9a29d338.png[/img]
[*]Tech Discovery

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403207/e29eac5d86af74af29e481cf43ad336fce704972.png[/img]
[*]Trade offer event

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403207/ca77c6ed7ecbba34984afcbbb9385a2b705fa0b3.png[/img]
[*]High Debt Event

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403207/860e653724a8c62ac3c51ba73b1fcd4c4bf3e76c.png[/img]
[/list]

[b]NEW RESEARCH OPTIONS[/b]
[list]
[*][b][LOGIBUS LOGIC ++][/b]: Logibus will not target random buildings anymore, they will go for the buildings that they can collect from.
[*][b][LOGIBUS SPEED ++][/b]: Logibus will not target random buildings anymore, they will go for the buildings that they can collect from.
[*][b][FIRM HANDSHAKE][/b]: Trade Agrements will earn double the amount that it used to.
[*][b][DUMBOT DETERRENT][/b]: Amount of Defbots we build will make Dumbot encounters more rare."
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403207/acee75995dc4e96615c197ee7b2c36ea91f6720e.png[/img]

[b]CHANGES & FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Bug fixes in the 5 year report: Net profit and revenue will be calculated better
[*]Asia-Pacific Electrolyser Global Project is Complete.
[*]Bug that disabled the Faction Criticizing is now fixed.
[*]Time will pause for Notification Alerts.
[*]Can move buildings even during War or approaching Asteroid
[*]New mining system : On the surface, the mechanic is the same but now it is much more reliable & bug-free.
[*][i]Mining Reward = EP + Worker, this reward is increased by +%25/50/75 for every new Mine-base built depending on the Lo/Mi/Hi selected.[/i]
[*]New Global Project: Lunar Gateway Global Project
[*]Feng Shui is effected by karma now.
[*]Market Automation is removed from the game, it was badly implemented and was not working as intended.
[*]Log entries will no longer overlap.
[*]The amount bar in Commodity Market no longer resets.[/list]

notes.title: Online Bond Market, Debt System Overhaul & Space Elevator Project Completion.
notes.content:
[b]The Bond Market[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403207/3f19dcedfa49ba3130462d572c8cdaa6dad89478.png[/img]

The new Bond Market rewards the players who hold bonds with interest from the Venture Pool.
Venture Pool is constantly growing. When a player buys a bond or pays the annual fee it will be added to the pool.

Access this new mechanic through the Finance Panel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403207/cd7f93f74b49921e982e573411cb473f5dcda258.png[/img]

[b]Global Project[/b]

The Space Elevator project is now completed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403207/142d3b177c18212392f8d9b8cab0b8c96aff5d58.png[/img]

This had the permanent effect on the game and now all new games will start with more Workers and Minerals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403207/cd29fb39e3ad91ac49e726d47f83650b9ab9f502.png[/img]

There is a new global project now. Cooperate with other players and help the funding and construction of the Great Saharan Solar Grid in Africa!


[b]Debt System[/b]

Debt system is changed and simplified. You no longer have to pay all your debts before getting more. You can take debt every year at an amount defined by the game based on the debt you already have + company market value.

[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Can no longer sell negative amount of commodities in the Market.
[*] You can now fire your last lawyer.
[/list]

Thank you for playing.

notes.title: [Update V1.1 & V1.2] Global Project, Bond Market, Bug Fixes & Optimizations
notes.content:
[b]GLOBAL PROJECTS[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403207/8c6aca949d561833aae9a164d8c8c61963e82fbb.png[/img]

There will now be mega projects that players can team up to fund and complete. When a project is completed it will have permanent changes on the game, usually benefits to all players.

[b]You can observe the megaproject on the Earth model in the game evolve as the global funding rate increases for the project.[/b]

First Global Project is a Space Elevator in Antarctica being constructed by Xian-Bei and New World factions. This will make access to space much easier, as a beneficiary you should be funding and helping this project. Funding may also help your relations with these factions and lower your dependency.

There is a new achievement related to this new mechanic. If you contributed to a Global Project you will receive it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403207/f92d89b7b948892bf4e062eeadb80b91f44ade73.png[/img]

[b]The Bond Market[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403207/3f19dcedfa49ba3130462d572c8cdaa6dad89478.png[/img]

The new Bond Market rewards the players who hold bonds with interest from the Venture Pool.
Venture Pool is constantly growing. When a player buys a bond or pays the annual fee it will be added to the pool.

Access this new mechanic through the Finance Panel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403207/cd7f93f74b49921e982e573411cb473f5dcda258.png[/img]

[b]Unlock Camera Button[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403207/e0d8d00761cf03865447b68245d3436a30f86c8e.png[/img]

There is a camera unlock/lock button on the top bar, when camera is unlocked it can be controlled using the "WASD" keys.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Can no longer hire more than 15-16 Board Members
[*] Saving and auto-saving is now optimized and any freeze that may occur became mostly unnoticeable.
[*] Destroying enemies no longer causes bad karma.
[*] Dumbots (red small enemies) spawn once per three years.
[*] Board votes can't be more than the amount of board members.
[*] World dependency is calculated more frequently.
[*] Rewarding Workers with Shares will cause much less share inflation.
[*] 5 Years Annual Report mechanic is working now.
[*] Typo fixes.
[*] Many big and small bug fixes.
[/list]

Thank you very much to everybody who reported bugs and shared feedback.
([yep] Klaus., LegioNemesis, Vasquez, Vincent and BrianRubin)
